depicts: Close-up render of a glossy dark-red textured ant head with black eye, antennae and serrated mandibles over blurred grass and dirt.
composition: Head fills the centre and right of the frame, tilted; body and legs cut off at the top left. Blurred grass background fills the left and bottom edges.
tone_and_contrast: Warm mid exposure. Dark glossy subject with specular highlights against lighter olive-yellow grass; subject and background separate clearly by lightness.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Fine wrinkled surface detail on the head is visible at native size; background is soft (depth-of-field blur). Some soft edges and mild compression texture in the grass. No overlays or watermarks.
scan_first_read: A large shiny ant head in close-up; reads as a detailed creature model.
